reminders.text: Stop chasing dopamine.
Think long term.
One payout won't change anything. Being disciplined will.
Slow down. The process is the edge.
Do not buy another account.
Another eval is not a fresh start. It is the same habit with a new bill.
A reset does not fix the thing that blew the last one.
You already have an account. Trade that one.
The checkout page is the dopamine. Close it.
If you feel the rush to buy, that is the signal to stop.
Rushing the next trade gives the last one back.
If you are in a hurry, you are not ready. Wait.
One clean session is worth more than a stack of new accounts.
The payout follows the discipline. It never leads it.
Do not shop for a firm while the market is open.
Boredom is not a reason to click buy.
Protect the account you have. That is the work today.
Long term is just the days you refused to rush.
Your edge is repetition, not a new login.
Trade the XFA you have. No new eval. No reset.
